title: Pre-Adamic cosmic war wipes out the civilization on Mars

tellings.quote: in that process, in this conflict, the civilization on Mars was eviscerated.

plain: In a war fought across the solar system before the time of Adam, the first man in the Bible, a civilization living on Mars was destroyed. That is how a researcher named Tim Alberino tells it to Michels, drawing on a writer named David Flynn and on works called Cydonia and Birthright, and in his words "the civilization on Mars was eviscerated." If true, it would mean Mars once held a civilization that was lost in an ancient cosmic conflict.
